# Cartesian School — Python from Zero

> A free, structured Python 3.14 course for absolute beginners, published by Cartesian School. Combines written theory with a canonical Jupyter notebook per lesson, and — for Chapter 3 so far — executable, browser-based practice powered by Python 3.14 via Pyodide, with automatic grading and local progress tracking. No install required for the in-browser practice; every notebook is also downloadable for local use.

Cartesian School — Python from Zero ("Python с нуля") is a Russian-language beginner Python course: 24 chapters covering programming fundamentals, Python syntax, data structures, functions, files, and small projects, each paired with a canonical Jupyter notebook. The visible course content is in Russian (`lang="ru"`); this file and other crawler-facing documentation are in English.

## Notes for crawlers

- Canonical host: https://www.cartesianschool.org — treat any *.vercel.app URL as a non-canonical preview, not the site of record.
- Interactive practice pages (`/practice/*/`) are thin application shells around notebook content already represented on their linked theory page; they are marked `noindex, follow` and are not the primary content to index.
